## Module 10. 基因调控网络分析

使用igraph构建基于差异Peak关联基因和转录因子的调控网络。

```{r network_analysis}
network_peak_genes <- if(file.exists(step_table_file("Step7", "Annotated_DiffPeaks.csv"))) {
  read.csv(step_table_file("Step7", "Annotated_DiffPeaks.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
} else {
  data.frame()
}
if(nrow(network_peak_genes) > 0 && "SYMBOL" %in% colnames(network_peak_genes) && !"geneSymbol" %in% colnames(network_peak_genes)) {
  colnames(network_peak_genes)[colnames(network_peak_genes) == "SYMBOL"] <- "geneSymbol"
}

network_edges <- data.frame()
network_edge_source <- NA_character_

candidate_network_tables <- list(
  Step09_TF_Target_Module = read_step_table("Step9", "TF_Target_Module_Edges.csv"),
  Step09_Footprint_Motif_Target = read_step_table("Step9", "Footprint_Supported_Motif_Target_Edges.csv")
)

for(edge_name in names(candidate_network_tables)) {
  edge_tbl <- candidate_network_tables[[edge_name]]
  if(nrow(edge_tbl) == 0) next
  if(all(c("motif_name", "geneSymbol") %in% colnames(edge_tbl))) {
    network_edges <- edge_tbl %>%
      transmute(source = motif_name, target = geneSymbol, type = "footprint_or_motif_site_supported")
  } else if(all(c("source", "target") %in% colnames(edge_tbl))) {
    network_edges <- edge_tbl %>%
      transmute(source = source, target = target, type = if("type" %in% colnames(edge_tbl)) type else "evidence_supported")
  }
  network_edges <- network_edges %>%
    filter(!is.na(source), source != "", !is.na(target), target != "") %>%
    distinct()
  if(nrow(network_edges) > 0) {
    network_edge_source <- edge_name
    break
  }
}

if(nrow(network_edges) > 0) {
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(network_edges, directed = TRUE)
  set.seed(123)
  p_network <- ggraph(g, layout = "fr") +
    geom_edge_link(alpha = 0.35, edge_width = 0.5, color = viz_pal$neutral_dark) +
    geom_node_point(aes(size = degree(g)), color = viz_pal$motif) +
    geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE, size = 3) +
    theme_void() +
    labs(title = "Evidence-supported TF-target gene regulatory network",
         subtitle = paste("Edge source:", network_edge_source))
  save_plot_pdf(
    p_network,
    step_plot_file("Step10", "TF_Target_Network.pdf"),
    width = 12,
    height = 10,
    coordinate_system = "none"
  )
  print(p_network)

  write.csv(network_edges, step_table_file("Step10", "Network_Edges.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  node_degrees <- degree(g)
  betweenness_centrality <- betweenness(g)
  pagerank_scores <- page_rank(g)$vector

  network_stats <- data.frame(
    gene = names(node_degrees),
    degree = node_degrees,
    betweenness = betweenness_centrality,
    pagerank = pagerank_scores
  )

  write.csv(network_stats, step_table_file("Step10", "Network_Node_Statistics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  cat("网络节点数:", vcount(g), "\n")
  cat("网络边数:", ecount(g), "\n")
  cat("平均度数:", mean(node_degrees), "\n")
} else {
  write_skipped_state(
    "Step10",
    "TF_Target_Network",
    "No footprint- or motif-site-supported TF-target edge table was available; skipped pseudo TF-target inference.",
    clear_plot_files = "TF_Target_Network.pdf"
  )
}

write_module_status_plot("Step10", "Module 10 TF-gene network status")
```
